newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is apt to refrain from open market operations on Tuesday, with Fed funds at a soft 5-1/8 percent, analysts said.

"It looks as though we will have a repeat of yesterday," said analysts at MMS International. "Treasury deposits remained very weak on Friday, limiting desk intervention, and we suspect the desk can again stay out today."
The Fed refrained from open market operations on Monday.
The mid-morning Federal funds quote of 5-1/8 percent is below the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
